# Get Your O.N.S Clothing Order with Same Day Delivery


We’re excited to announce our partnership with[O.N.S Clothing](https://www.onsclothing.com/) to offer same-day delivery for their customers in Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens! With the[Getcho Shopify App](https://apps.shopify.com/same-day-delivery-by-getcho) integrated directly into the O.N.S Clothing website, users can now shop online and select same-day delivery with ease. Enjoy a fast and reliable service that brings your favorite O.N.S styles straight to your door.


## How to Order O.N.S Clothing for Same Day Delivery


Ordering from O.N.S Clothing for same day delivery is straightforward. After adding items to your cart, proceed to checkout, enter your zip code, and if you’re in an eligible area in New York, the “Same Day Delivery” option will appear.


### Steps to Get Same Day Delivery with Getcho


1.


[Visit the O.N.S Site](https://www.onsclothing.com/)
Browse the O.N.S Clothing website and add your favorite items to your cart.


2.


**Proceed to Checkout**
After you’ve finalized your shopping, go to checkout.


3.


**Enter Your Zip Code**
Type in your zip code to check if same-day delivery is available in your area. If eligible, the **Same Day Delivery** option will appear in the shipping methods.


4.


**Choose Same Day Delivery**
In the shipping options, select **Same Day Delivery** . Orders placed by 5 pm will arrive the same day. Orders after 5 pm will be delivered the next day.


1.


**Delivery Details**
Enter your mobile number and any special delivery instructions to help the courier.


2.


**Complete Your Order**
Confirm your payment and order details. Same-day delivery is **free** for orders over $150; otherwise, a $10 fee applies.


## Why Choose Getcho for O.N.S Clothing Delivery?


With Getcho’s integration directly into the O.N.S Clothing Shopify platform, customers within most of Brooklyn, all of Manhattan, and parts of Queens can benefit from same-day delivery. Enjoy the following benefits:


1. **Speed** – Your order will arrive within an hour for most locations.
2. **Convenience** – Shop online and get your items delivered fast.
3. **Reliability** – Experienced couriers ensure a smooth delivery.
4. **Real-Time Tracking** – Stay updated with tracking and notifications.


This streamlined process ensures you have your O.N.S Clothing items quickly and efficiently. Perfect for city dwellers who appreciate both style and convenience, Getcho brings your O.N.S purchases directly to your doorstep.
